entities.name: Rashidun Caliphate
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Rashidun Caliphate, a political institution in Iran during Sassanid Empire (633–651). Grew from Khosrow I and Sassanid Zenith and Shapur I captures Roman Emperor Valerian at the Battle of Edessa. Led to the emergence of Sassanid Empire and Battle of al-Qadisiyyah — Arab forces defeat the Sassanid army.
